candidates.change_summary: Replace the addition assignment with subtraction assignment, decreasing the balance instead of increasing it.
Replace the require condition with a false-like condition that always reverts, making Deposit always fail to update balances.
Replace the require condition with msg.sender != address(0) so Deposit succeeds only for non-zero addresses, changing balances for some calls.
Replace msg.sender with address(0) in the balance update, crediting the zero address instead of the caller.
Replace msg.value with 1 in the balance update, so only 1 wei is added regardless of actual ether sent.
Replace msg.value with 0 in the balance update, so no balance is added despite ether being sent.
Move the balance update to after the Log.AddMessage call, causing Log entry to reflect pre-update state but balances are still updated.
